restart: fresh initialization, no previous non-HER checkpoints loaded
scheduling: Parallel seeds per method, independent next-task launch only after that method completes all five seeds

her.sampled_from: completed episodes only; inclusive current-to-future next achieved goals within the same episode
her.reward: recompute with the original environment compute_reward
her.storage: raw observations and true physical next observations; metadata preserved for episode boundaries and future goals
her.timeout: bootstrap at the 50-step time limit; relabeled successes do not create terminal states

observation_normalization.order: relabel raw desired goals and rewards first, normalize both observations with current training statistics afterward
observation_normalization.evaluation: original desired goals, no HER relabeling; frozen training normalization statistics

ibolt.overlap: reuse selected sweep seeds 0/1; append fresh seeds 2/3/4

evaluation.primary: final-step is_success; additionally report new success excluding initial-success episodes

previous_experiments: Stopped 39 batch-2048 non-HER Fetch runs and cancelled 117 follow-up jobs; existing results/checkpoints preserved
scope: Fetch only; PointMaze and GMM untouched

validation.cpu_checks_on_both_servers: all four Fetch tasks: no cross-episode sampling, ring-buffer overwrite, reward recomputation, raw-state preservation, normalization, timeout masking, native/SB3/IDAC interface consistency and serialization passed
